author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** Reshape MemoryAnomalyDetector bucket counters u64 → f64 to accept reputation-weighted per-event scores. observe_report signature gains weight: f32 (default 1.0 for unweighted callers). Welford running statistics operate on weighted sums. Hook into action insert path (or report insert) consuming PgReputationProvider::score_for. Tests: weighted vs unweighted detection produce different z-scores for the same input.
